name: Front Desk Opening Checklist
clockoutRule: Roster-linked for opening staff; skipped items require note and manager review
items:
Unlock front entry and staff access doors
Turn on reception computers, printers, scanner and EFTPOS
Confirm phones are active and after-hours diversion is off
Open Best Practice on approved reception workstation
Check waiting room, reception desk and notice area are tidy
Check front desk cash/EFTPOS float readiness if used
Check vaccine fridge AM temperature is recorded when assigned to reception
Report any IT, facility or safety issue before first session

name: Front Desk Closing Checklist
clockoutRule: Roster-linked for closing staff; actual clock-out is saved, exceptions go to manager
items:
Confirm waiting room and public areas are clear
Secure reception documents, scripts and confidential paperwork
Switch phones to after-hours message or approved diversion
Close Best Practice and log out of shared workstations
Turn off non-essential equipment and lights
Check doors/windows, set alarm and lock premises
Record unresolved issues in Communication Book or Tasks
Check vaccine fridge PM temperature is recorded when assigned to reception

name: Daily Nursing Duties
clockoutRule: Appears on nurse dashboard and time-out workflow where assigned
items:
Attend to sterilization
Attend to nurse in-tray
Attend to urgent and non-urgent recalls
Check oxygen cylinder
Check fridge temperature AM/PM
Empty clinical waste bin / verify cleaner completion
Empty general waste bin / verify cleaner completion
Restock treatment room
Restock doctor rooms
Disinfect all bench tops and beds

name: Weekly Nursing Duties
clockoutRule: Reminder at 3 days and 1 day before due date; does not block clock-in/out
items:
QML pathology stock order
S & N stock order
Steriliser maintenance
Check emergency trolley

name: Monthly Nursing Duties
clockoutRule: Recurring monthly dates on 1st, 14th and 25th; does not block clock-in/out
items:
1st of month: check Doctor Bag / emergency medications
1st of month: order Doctor Bag / emergency medications
14th of month: stock order for treatment rooms
25th of month: NIP vaccine order

name: Emergency Trolley Checklist
clockoutRule: Weekly emergency readiness evidence with expiry fields
items:
Drawer 1: Anaphylaxis kit and adrenaline 1:1000
Drawer 1: alcohol swabs and conforming bandages
Drawer 1: IV catheters 18G/20G/22G
Drawer 1: tourniquet and winged infusion sets
Drawer 2: adult and paediatric nebulising kits
Drawer 2: adult and paediatric oxygen masks
Drawer 3: suction tubing, Yankauer suction and tracheal tubes
Drawer 3: normal saline and D5 solution
Drawer 4: disposable resuscitator with adult, paediatric and infant masks
Record expiry dates and checked-by details

name: Instrument Log
clockoutRule: Daily sterilisation evidence; failed cycle requires manager review
items:
Record instrument set / pack ID
Record sterilisation cycle or batch number
Record autoclave result / indicator status
Record date/time processed
Record processed by nurse
Attach exception note if cycle failed
Manager review of failed cycle before reuse

name: Manager AGPAL / RACGP Assessment Readiness Checklist
clockoutRule: Manager dashboard reminder; evidence pack readiness
sourceDocument: Accreditation - AGPAL On-site Assessment Preparation Checklist
items:
Confirm clinical health record evidence list is ready where applicable
Confirm clinical management evidence and guidelines are available
Confirm personnel records: AHPRA, CPR, immunisation, appraisal and induction
Confirm governance responsibilities are documented
Confirm practice documentation, policies and procedures have review dates
Confirm QI/PDSA register evidence is current
Confirm cold chain evidence and self-audit are available
Confirm surveyor-ready evidence pack is complete
